## Checklist

- [ ] Branched from `develop`; the pull request targets `develop`
- [ ] Commit messages are conventional (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `build:`, `docs:`, `chore:`)
- [ ] `./gradlew apiCheck` passes; if the public API changed on purpose, `./gradlew apiDump` was run and the updated `.api` files are committed
- [ ] Unit tests pass and new behaviour has a test
- [ ] No `Co-Authored-By` or "Generated with" lines in commits or the description
